text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... *gasp*...
*pant*... Finally, it's over...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (My legs are so heavy... Wow, I'm really exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Still... it just means it was that much of an exhausting battle, right? Yeah, that must be it.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(...Because I really did give it my all.
Even though it was a GⅠ, I still got solid results...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!
I can keep going~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Next is the spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen!
Medium distance doesn't matter at all to me!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing!
Running consecutive GⅠs like that... Doesn't she get tired?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not tired at all, in fact I'm all fired up!
Please cheer for meeeee!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooo!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Is that what an Umamusume looks like when she still has a bright future ahead of her...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm back~!
That race really gave me a lot to think about, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Umm, next is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me, Trainer.
Would it be alright if I ran in another GⅠ before the Japan Cup?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Because Maruzen-san is so strong. Taking her on directly like this won't stand a chance!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I know I need more experience.
So please... I'm begging you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "True, to be fully prepared for the Japan Cup, we really could have used one more race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Preferably at Tokyo Racecourse, just like
the Japan Cup. Thinking about it that way—"
choice_data_list: What do you think about the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...That's the race where I competed against
Tamamo-san and Oguri-san last year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it. I can do this.
And there, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll win, and show everyone
that I'm an Umamusume with potential left in me!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hah... *sigh*... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"This feeling... it's amazing...!
Not bad at all—in fact—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Whew♪ As expected of Maruzen,
didn't you just regain your peak form?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not true at all.
I mean, my peak was even more incredible.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Fufu, just you watch.
Competing against Spe-chan
brought quite a fruitful takeaway.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm in pretty good shape right now, too.
At this rate, I can run at full throttle to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Maruzen going all out.
The time has finally come to witness it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well, yeah. It was probably her first time giving it her absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Your peak is already past, and I thought it'd just end without you ever giving it your all, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Nothing like that happened.
I'm really looking forward to the upcoming Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before I finished walking Sakura Chiyono O
back to her dorm, she suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Could you please keep my current condition
a secret from everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get good results in today's race as well.
So I'm sure I can do my best in the next Tenno Sho (Autumn) too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't want people nagging me if they found out. Since things are still uncertain, I'd rather keep it a secret.
choice_data_list: Got it, I won't tell anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll be fine!
So... I'm counting on you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sure everyone must have been completely exhausted
after running all out in today's race.
It just didn't show on their faces, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So it definitely wasn't
just me who was tired.
...Surely.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Please, I'm begging you.
I just want to believe my peak hasn't passed yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack-crack... crack)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So by next time... by the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
I just want this weird feeling that something's slipping away to be gone...!"
